name: Paris
line: Every café chair faces the street, so I did too. The pastries won.

name: London
line: It rained for ten minutes, then the sun came out over the river. Typical.

name: Rome
line: Ate gelato on steps older than most countries. Saved you a spoonful.

name: Amsterdam
line: More bicycles than people, and every one of them knows where it's going.

name: Lisbon
line: The trams climb hills that would tire a goat. Wish you were here.

name: Prague
line: The astronomical clock struck the hour and the whole square looked up.

name: Dubrovnik
line: Walked the old walls at sunset. The sea was the bluest thing I've seen.

name: Reykjavík
line: The pool is outdoors, the snow is falling, and nobody minds at all.

name: Tromsø
line: The sun forgot to set again. I've stopped checking the time.

name: Tbilisi
line: Sulphur baths, warm bread from a clay oven, and wine poured like water.

name: Tokyo
line: The trains run to the second, and the vending machines sell hot soup.

name: Seoul
line: Climbed to the palace gate at dawn, then ate pancakes from a market stall.

name: Singapore
line: Supper at a hawker centre: seven stalls, one table, no regrets.

name: Bangkok
line: A longtail boat, a temple glittering on the river, mango sticky rice after.

name: Hanoi
line: Crossed the road among a thousand scooters. Rewarded myself with egg coffee.

name: Jaipur
line: The whole old city is pink. The elephants seem quite used to it.

name: Taipei
line: Night market dumplings, then up the tallest tower to see it all lit.

name: Luang Prabang
line: Monks walked by in saffron at first light. The Mekong took its time.

name: Ulaanbaatar
line: Slept in a ger under more stars than I knew there were.

name: Samarkand
line: Blue-tiled domes so bright the sky looked pale beside them.

name: New York
line: Walked the whole length of the park and still haven't seen half the city.

name: Toronto
line: Took the ferry to the islands and looked back at the skyline. Quite something.

name: Mexico City
line: Tacos al pastor at midnight, mariachi on the corner. Nobody was in a hurry.

name: Rio de Janeiro
line: The mountain wears a statue and the beach wears everyone else.

name: Havana
line: Old cars in every colour and music from every doorway. Sent with salt air.

name: Cartagena
line: Inside the walls every balcony overflows with flowers. The heat is golden.

name: Cusco
line: The air is thin, the stones fit without mortar, and the coca tea helps.

name: Ushuaia
line: Last town before Antarctica. The penguins didn't seem impressed by me.

name: La Paz
line: Rode a cable car over the rooftops, with snowy peaks the whole way.

name: Nuuk
line: Painted houses on bare rock, and icebergs drifting past the harbour.
